def get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target: str) ->Tuple[List[
    Dict[str, Any]], List[str]]:
    ctx = SafetyContext()
    styled_items = []
    plain_items = []
    
    if scanning_target == 'environment':
        if not ctx.packages:
            no_locations = 'No locations found in the environment'
            styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': no_locations}]]
            plain_items = [no_locations]
        else:
            for pkg in ctx.packages:
                if isinstance(pkg, Package):
                    styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': pkg.name}])
                    plain_items.append(pkg.name)
    
    elif scanning_target == 'stdin':
        if not ctx.packages:
            no_packages = 'No found packages in stdin'
            styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': no_packages}]]
            plain_items = [no_packages]
        else:
            for pkg in ctx.packages:
                if isinstance(pkg, Package):
                    styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': pkg.name}])
                    plain_items.append(pkg.name)
    
    elif scanning_target == 'file':
        file_obj = ctx.params.get('file')
        if file_obj:
            styled_items = [[{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_obj.name}'}]]
            plain_items = [file_obj.name]
    
    elif scanning_target == 'files':
        files = ctx.params.get('files', [])
        for file_obj in files:
            styled_items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_obj.name}'}])
            plain_items.append(file_obj.name)
    
    return styled_items, plain_items
